RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 55

An all-male panel is not proof of discrimination on its own, but combined with the disparity in leadership qualifications (five years as deputy principal versus only coursework), it warrants scrutiny. 

Rather than alleging bias outright, first follow up firmly on the delayed written explanation and consult your union or an employment adviser. An all-male committee can be relevant context indicating potential affinity bias or lack of institutional safeguards, but it works best as supporting evidence. Your strongest position depends on whether the documentation shows that the panel deviated from objective, merit-based selection criteria to bypass your direct administrative experience.
